items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and then somebody called up and said Connie had a stroke, so Hogwood said why don’t we do it without the drums, and we did.

ctx.x: Christopher Hogwood and whatever that ensemble of his was playing these old Bach things on these other instruments. And Connie fell out in the store. He was buying some white ties. He was in Brooks Brothers or something trying to buy a white tie and fell out in the store with a stroke. And we were waiting for Connie, who was usually a little tardy getting in, and we said, “Aw, he’ll be up here on the next shuttle,” and he missed that one. He didn’t arrive, and then somebody called up and said Connie had a stroke,…
